description: Zsh shell built from source with the MSYS2 toolchain (portable runtime)
notes: zsh built from source with MSYS2; zip served from the develop branch of https://github.com/raliclo/zsh. The 'zsh' shim points at zsh-loader.exe (a native launcher), not zsh.cmd: scoop shims for a .cmd target still have to go through cmd.exe's own parser, which can truncate a multi-line -c script at the first newline and mangle characters like | inside quoted arguments. zsh-loader.exe forwards argv to the real interpreter (zsh.exe) untouched.
